AOCI-Wuch

 English 中文

 
 
 

 A task-first skill library for AI coding agents. 

Reusable workflows, reasoning methods, MCP setup, UI design, mobile, Excel, and video—indexed so the assistant finds a match, then reads only what it needs.

 Site → · Subscribe / auth · Stable index · Experimental index

 Why this library

 You get Meaning 
 --- --- 
 Task → catalog → one skill No dumping every guide into context at chat start 
 Stable vs Experimental Maturity is visible; experimental is never treated as proven 
 Free + PRO Public skills on GitHub; subscription skills via auth 
 Works with Cursor / similar Install the repo as an Agent Skill, then let the agent follow SKILL.md 

 Install

Install this repository as a reusable Agent Skill:

 

Or tell your assistant:

 

 How it works

 

The assistant should not load every capability body up front. Use capabilities/index.md (and the experimental index when appropriate), then open only the hit.

 Capability catalog

 Stable

 Capability Purpose 
 --- --- 
 GitHub App Authorization Run the user authorization flow for a given GitHub App 
 Native Mobile App Setup PRO Create and maintain iOS / Android apps with the mobile-template family 
 Logic Space Enumeration Enumerate valid scenarios, paths, and outcomes in complex designs 
 Excel Backend Selection Choose and wire file-level vs desktop Excel backends 
 iOS App Store & TestFlight PRO Ship an Xcode app to TestFlight and the App Store 
 DBX Database Setup Discover, configure, and verify DBX MCP for database access 
 Video Frame Extraction Extract ordered stills from video from natural-language requests 
 Design Style Canvas Confirm desired effects against the wuch-ai design anchor, then ship a style Canvas 
 UI Style Prompt Design PRO Confirm style first, then generate runnable UI 
 Lightweight SSO Login Center PRO Lightweight SSO Login Center 
 GA4 Analytics GA4 Analytics 
 GitHub OAuth Login GitHub OAuth Login 
 Email Magic Link Login Email Magic Link Login 
 Design Pattern OS PRO Design Pattern OS 
 AI Conversation Kit PRO AI Conversation Kit 
 Team Know Kit Team Know Kit 
 WorkBuddy Skill Publish WorkBuddy Skill Publish 

 Experimental

 Capability Purpose 
 --- --- 
 LibTV Media Setup Configure and verify LibTV Remote MCP 
 Workers Site Auth & Abuse Control GitHub OAuth / email login and rate limiting on Cloudflare Workers
